title: Uniform data.result block on every mutating command response
description: Every mutating --json command returns a stable data.result {id, kind, status, subjectId} alongside its existing payload (boreal.cli.result.v1). Ends the '.data.meta.id // .data.id // .data.verification.meta.id' guessing seen in both transcripts and the {ok:true,id:null} close.
acceptanceCriteria: Every mutating command's JSON response includes data.result with id, kind, status; schema versioned as boreal.cli.result.v1
bwrk commands output and docs/cli/COMMANDS.md document the data.result path once, globally
Runtime tests assert data.result on evidence add, work verify, summary compose/create, work close, sprint close, agent finish
